title: Ingestion queue: 80% drain threshold prevents oscillation, atomic try_send eliminates TOCTOU
description: transit/peering/ingestion_queue.rs: bounded queue with 80% capacity drain threshold prevents the fill-drain-fill oscillation that a simple full/empty boundary creates. try_send() makes the capacity check and enqueue atomic, eliminating the TOCTOU race that a separate check-then-send pattern would have. The concurrent flood test (lines 254-297) verifies capacity is never exceeded. Defend both design choices if a contributor proposes simplifying to a direct Tokio channel.
